content: As gold is tested in four ways—by rubbing, cutting, heating, and hammering—so is character tested by conduct, lineage, virtue, and action.
author: Sanskrit Subhashitas
sourceWork: Yatha chatur-bhih kanakam parikshyate (यथा चतुर्भिः कनकं परीक्ष्यते) — Chanakya Niti
explanation: Gilded brass looks identical to pure gold in dim light. Only when subjected to the jeweler's touchstone, the chisel, the fiery furnace, and the blacksmith's anvil is true purity proven. Adversity is the touchstone that reveals whether your virtue is genuine or merely painted on.
practicalInsight: When your patience and integrity are tested under pressure today, smile and recognize the crucible testing your gold.
reflectionPrompt: How has your recent conduct under stress revealed the true quality of your character?
